summary: The proof is correct. The projected endpoint areas are 1/3200 and 1/32, so A/B=1/100 and the strict residual strip forces B>100/101. Under compatibility, the chosen edge Minkowski average is a nondegenerate parallelogram contained in P1 with area 42 times |P2|, forcing B<=1/42. The fixed triangles are nondegenerate, the coordinate projection has the same area Jacobian on all parallel planes, and the accepted normal-form fact gives the stated matrix consequence.
